title: Morgan Stanley just downgraded Apple - and it reveals a growing complaint among analysts (AAPL)
text: Morgan Stanley just downgraded Apple — and it reveals a growing complaint among analysts (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Apr 20, 2018, 11:08 am 18 pts Morgan Stanley cut its price target from Apple stock from $203 to $200. One reason cited is "weak China data." Several notes in recent weeks have highlighted Apple's problems in China. Watch Apple trade in real time here.
